---
title: "era_pl: empirical research in accounting with Python"
---

`era_pl` provides Polars data and functions for the
[Python/Polars edition of *Empirical Research in Accounting: Tools and Methods*](https://iangow.github.io/era_pl_book/).
Install the **`era-py`** distribution and import **`era_pl`** in Python.
This is the API used by the book and its companion materials.

The same distribution also supplies the `era_py` pandas/Ibis API. Both
namespaces use the same packaged datasets, but their function coverage and
arguments differ.

See the [changelog](news/index.qmd) for recent additions and fixes, or the
[Python/Polars book](https://iangow.github.io/era_pl_book/) for worked examples.
The [function reference](reference/index.qmd) describes the APIs, and the
[dataset catalog](datasets/index.qmd) documents the included data.

## Installation

Install the package with its Polars extra:

```bash
pip install "era-py[polars]"
```

Add the extras required for your workflow:

```bash
pip install "era-py[polars,tables]"
pip install "era-py[polars,plots]"
```

Python 3.10 or later is required. The Polars extra requires Polars 2 or later.

The development version can be installed from GitHub:

```bash
pip install "era-py[polars] @ git+https://github.com/iangow/era_py.git"
```

## Packaged data

Load a dataset and inspect its documentation:

```python
from era_pl import data_info, load_data

camp = load_data("camp_attendance")
camp_info = data_info("camp_attendance")
```

`data_info(name)` returns a dataset's description, source, dimensions, schema,
and variable definitions without loading its observations. Use `data_catalog()`
to inspect every packaged dataset.

## Polars helpers

Importing `era_pl` also registers the `.era` namespace on Polars expressions
and dataframes. For example, form quantile groups with:

```python
import polars as pl
import era_pl

data = pl.DataFrame({"value": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]})
data.with_columns(bucket=pl.col("value").era.ntile(3))
```

The [reference](reference/index.qmd) groups functions for event dates, data
retrieval, models, data cleaning, tables, plots, and SEC indexes.

## Pandas and Ibis API

For pandas workflows, install `era-py` and import `era_py`. Its Ibis/Postgres
event-return and WRDS helpers additionally require `pip install "era-py[ibis]"`.
These functions have a separate section in the reference.

The `era_pl` event helpers currently construct event dates and windows;
`era_pl.get_event_rets()` and `era_pl.copy_inline()` are unimplemented.
Use the documented Ibis API where cumulative event-return calculations are
needed.
